scope: Same-Round2 BIND_OLD_CAPTURE supplemental audit before FIT_REFRESH
required_contract: Compare against frozen old target bytes whose SHA is already bound by the historical immutable output receipt, rather than accepting newly hashed substitute targets.
Bind current capture inputs, complete ordered row metadata, FIT120 selection and all eight operator target mappings; validate row counts, dimensions and identity before recomputation.
Use pinned canonical weights and numerical implementation/environment; preserve exact bitwise mismatch diagnostics without changing source captures or frozen labels.

Ensure capture, metadata and target contents remain stable across the audit using content hashes and stat evidence; the audit PASS is atomic only after all prescribed old FIT120/eight-operator comparisons pass.
Bind FIT_REFRESH release to the audit-completion receipt plus exact current capture, metadata, historical target, weights, numerical source/binary and audit-source hashes.
Account for all verification queries separately; introduce no new model states, calibration rows, fit grid or second refresh. Every family uses the same verified labels.
mismatch_policy: Hold FIT_REFRESH and investigate numerical/provenance/wiring causes. Preserve mismatches; do not overwrite labels, relax equality, exclude rows or refit around failures. A technical mismatch is not a scientific failed round.
permitted_conclusion_after_pass: The currently pinned X and row mapping have exact canonical targets equal to the historically frozen Y, establishing a usable supervised binding for the new refit.
excluded_conclusion: The audit does not reconstruct or certify historical capture input provenance, nor independently validate the original historical state trajectories.
reviewer_actions: Reviewed the parent-proposed audit contract only.
Read only the existing critic research note.
Did not read or hash activation, row, weight, target or corpus payloads.
Did not execute candidate code, numerical recomputation or probes.
source_gate: Collector/audit/fixed-fit source and immutable hash review remain required; Root must separately release BIND_OLD_CAPTURE and later FIT_REFRESH.
